cause: The local Olmo snapshot path in the launch omitted the cache's hub subdirectory. Tokenizer configuration resolution failed before loading model weights or issuing generate.
resolution: Read-only find verified the exact revisions for all three model snapshots. Both main model directories are under hf-cache/hub; Mistral is directly under hf-cache. Correct the path without changing weights or frozen probe inputs.
accounting: Retain elapsed time under the explicit failure identity. No attempts or previous consumed GPU time are deleted. Do not keep guessing snapshot paths.
